sources.claim_locator: Writing a task; Communication; Top level Python Code
sources.claims_supported: Airflow tasks should be designed to yield the same outcome on rerun; the guidance recommends reading and writing specific data partitions and avoiding non-idempotent inserts. It also advises against relying on local files for inter-task communication in distributed executors, recommends remote storage for larger data, and warns against expensive or side-effecting top-level DAG code because the scheduler repeatedly parses DAG files.
sources.limitations: Documentation guidance, not a guarantee of correctness for a particular pipeline. Recommendations depend on executor and workload; no implementation or task behavior was tested. No publication or version date was verified.
